parole.testo: From Sogdian [script needed] (ʾʾγʾz /⁠āγāz⁠/), from Proto-Iranian *ā- (“ad-”) + *gaHz- (“to run, start”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₂ed- (“at”) + *g⁽ʷʰ⁾eh₂ģʰ- (“to wade”). Cognate with Sanskrit गाह् (gāh, “to dive into, wade”), Slovene gáziti (“to wade”).
Borrowed from Sogdian [Term?], from Proto-Iranian *dúgdā. Akin to Persian دختر (doxtar, “girl, daughter”) and Persian دخت (doxt, “daughter, damsel”).

parole.significato: orchard; a garden where fruits are grown
parole.testo: Borrowed from Sogdian prδyz (/⁠parδēz⁠/, “fruit garden; orchard”), from Proto-Iranian *paridayjah. Doublet of پردیس (pardis) and فردوس (ferdows).
